title: Samsung RS28 — Engineer mode / Force Run entry
description: Enter Fridge Function Test for Force Run and Force Defrost (§4-2-1).

steps.title: Enter engineer mode
steps.body: Within 3 s touch A-B-A-B-A-B on display (toast: Engineer mode). Choose Fridge Function Test.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Within 3 s touch A-B-A-B-A-B on display (toast: Engineer mode). Choose Fridge Function Test.

steps.title: Force Run / Force Defrost
steps.body: Force Run 1/2/3 (FF 1/2/A) runs compressor + F-fan 24 h. Force Defrost (Fd) defrosts F+R compartments. TEST CANCEL or power cycle exits.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Force Run 1/2/3 (FF 1/2/A) runs compressor + F-fan 24 h. Force Defrost (Fd) defrosts F+R compartments. TEST CANCEL or power cycle exits.
